baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb يُعَذِّبُ, its cognate noun عَذَابَ, the explicit subject ٱللَّهُ, and the qualifier أَكْبَرَ form a complete agent-action-object-scale construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated ع ذ ب root turns punishment into both an enacted process and a named result; the divine name fixes the agent, while أَكْبَرَ ranks the result by degree.

activation_trace.role: Torment and severe punishment supply the direct penal sense, while the verb-noun doubling makes it both act and resulting condition.
The fixed divine name literally identifies Allah and assigns the punishing agency to Him.
Greatness as the opposite of smallness supplies the scale on which the punishment is ranked.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces an unspecified severe penalty.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a fully assigned penal event: Allah actively makes the referent undergo punishment, names that condition again, and grades it as the greater one.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ع ذ ب root can activate not only torment but also palatability, bodily abstention, and active withholding within the focus inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative verb can be heard alongside the root's withholding and weaning branch: punishment is not only pain added to a body but access to relief actively removed from it.

activation_trace.role: Fresh palatability supplies the absent good whose loss gives deprivation a sensory edge.
Bodily abstention from food and drink supplies the somatic state into which the punished person may be driven.
Withholding and weaning supply the operative mechanism of removing access rather than merely adding pain.
Punishment keeps the deprivation model anchored in the actual penal construction rather than replacing it with a free metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is positive pain imposed on the sufferer.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading hears punishment as an imposed deprivation regime: sweetness, intake, and relief are withheld until abstention itself becomes torment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَكْبَرَ can qualify the عَذَاب not only by abstract magnitude but by the burden and chief share carried by the sufferer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ك ب ر inventory shifts the scalar adjective from simple quantity toward heaviness and the bulk of an affair; the punishment is greater because it is harder to bear and occupies the chief burden.

activation_trace.role: Severe punishment supplies the burden-bearing event that the adjective recalibrates.
The chief share or bulk of an affair makes greater denote the dominant portion of the consequence.
Greatness as hardship and heaviness converts scalar size into felt difficulty of carrying the punishment.

changed_reading.before: Greater indicates only a higher point on a scale of intensity.
changed_reading.after: Greater also marks the punishment as the chief, uncarryable burden, a qualitative excess over the sufferer's capacity rather than merely more units of pain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two face-groups create rival economies of effort: one works into exhaustion, while the other is satisfied with its striving. The focus withholding branch makes the greater punishment legible as labor whose yield, wage, and relief never arrive.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and weaning turn punishment into the blocking of an expected return from effort.
Torment keeps the blocked-yield mechanism penal rather than merely economic.
Hardship and heaviness make the endless work-load a quality of the greater punishment.
Intentional work supplies productive effort as the first side of the contrast.
The wage or provision of work supplies the expected yield whose absence makes the labor punitive.
Exhausting toil supplies the bodily cost of work severed from recompense.
Work and earning supply the parallel effort on the satisfied side of the contrast.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies the successful result withheld from the exhausted workers.

structural_cues: 88:3 couples work with exhaustion, whereas 88:9 couples striving with satisfaction.
The focus repeats ع ذ ب as verb and cognate noun, allowing blocked yield to become both an operation and a settled condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intentional work, a wage branch, exhaustion, earning, satisfaction, and focus-side withholding; I infer an arrow from effort to an expected yield and then its blockage. A live alternative is that the two work descriptions contrast destinies without encoding a wage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is a discrete painful event after refusal.
changed_reading.after: The punishment can be a counter-wage system: effort continues and grows heavy, but every nourishing or satisfying return from that effort is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fire, heated spring, forced drink, food, failed fattening, failed sufficiency, and hunger sequence turns the focus root's palatability, abstention, and withholding branches into a closed anti-nourishment circuit. Apparent provision is delivered, but it intensifies the need it should resolve.

activation_trace.role: Fresh palatability supplies the precise sensory good inverted by the surrounding drink and food.
Abstention from food and drink supplies the bodily deprivation produced despite the presence of consumables.
Withholding and weaning provide the causal operation by which relief is denied.
Torment and punishment anchor the anti-nourishment circuit as a mode of punishment.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the bodily environment in which drink cannot cool or relieve.
Heating supplies the thermal force that converts offered liquid into injury.
Giving drink supplies the literal act of provisioning that the mechanism reverses.
The non-dominant mapped image of driving and expulsion contributes a tentative coercive vector to the passive giving of drink.
A flowing-water source supplies the expected origin of refreshment on the punitive side.
Reaching full term supplies the liquid's completed, fully arrived condition rather than a passing warmth.
Tasting and taking food supply ingestion without successful nourishment.
Fatness opposed to emaciation supplies the bodily result that the food explicitly fails to produce.
Sufficiency supplies the functional relief that the food explicitly fails to provide.
An empty belly supplies the unresolved need left intact after eating.
The second spring repeats the water-source image on the contrasting side, where it can function as genuine provision.
Continuous flowing supplies an unobstructed provision pattern opposed to punitive withholding.

structural_cues: 88:5 uses passive provisioning, 88:6 narrows food through an exception, and 88:7 negates both nourishment and relief.
The spring of 88:5 and the flowing spring of 88:12 form a same-domain contrast between counterfeit and successful provision.
The focus's causative verb plus cognate noun lets deprivation operate repeatedly and settle as a condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, drinking, springs, ingestion, bodily nourishment, sufficiency, hunger, and the focus branches for palatability, abstention, and withholding; I infer that failed provision is an engineered feedback loop. The non-dominant س و ق image adds only a tentative coercive arrow, and the live alternative is a simple list of distinct torments rather than one system.

changed_reading.before: The surrounding food and drink are separate examples of pain, while 88:24 merely names punishment in general.
changed_reading.after: The greater punishment becomes an integrated anti-sustenance system: the victim is made to consume, yet consumption withholds sweetness, nourishment, sufficiency, and the ending of hunger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Raised garden space, elevated couches, raised sky, erected mountains, and spread earth provide a sequence of load-bearing scales. Against that sequence, أَكْبَرَ can mark a punishment whose heaviness exceeds creaturely carrying capacity while remaining within the agency that orders world-scale structures.

activation_trace.role: Greatness supplies the explicit scalar anchor that the spatial sequence can recalibrate.
Hardship and heaviness convert visible scale into an unbearable load on the punished person.
Elevation supplies the first explicit vertical scale in the favorable scene.
Raising an object supplies a human-scale instance of ordered elevation.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the world-scale upper structure.
The sky's raising repeats elevation at a scale far beyond the couches.
A high solid mass supplies visible weight and load-bearing resistance.
Setting something upright and prominent supplies the mountains' imposed stability.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the other bound of the spatial scale.
A level extended surface supplies ordered breadth in contrast to vertical raising.

structural_cues: The branchless root ك ي ف recurs at 88:17-20 as a fourfold structural demand to inspect how large forms are made.
The passive sequence created, raised, erected, and spread alternates vertical and horizontal acts before the explicit divine agency of 88:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevated, upright, massive, and extended structures plus the focus branch of burdensome greatness; I infer that these structures furnish an experiential scale for أَكْبَرَ and an agency-capacity contrast. A live alternative is that the creation sequence demonstrates power without becoming a comparand for the punishment.

changed_reading.before: Greater is an abstract intensifier with no felt measure.
changed_reading.after: Greater acquires architectural weight: the punishment is an uncarryable load heard against the same agency's raising, erecting, and spreading of structures from couch to cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: A report arrives, perception is directed toward measurable creation, reminder reactivates what can be known, concealment blocks it, and examination closes the sequence. The initial فَ of فَيُعَذِّبُهُ then reads as a consequence after multiple modes of disclosure rather than an unprepared threat.

activation_trace.role: Punishment supplies the consequence whose evidentiary position is being revised.
The chief burden of the affair lets greater register the accumulated weight of refused disclosure.
Coming and arrival supply the first movement of information toward the addressee.
Renewed speech as report supplies an audible disclosure channel.
Directing sight or insight supplies deliberate examination rather than passive exposure.
Proportioning and measuring supply an intelligible order available to inspection.
Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies renewed cognitive access.
Concealing the truth supplies an active obstruction after disclosure.
Examining a matter supplies the closing review that makes the sequence accountable.

structural_cues: The surah begins with a question about an arriving report and ends with return and accounting.
The branchless ك ي ف cue repeats four times in 88:17-20 and therefore supports inquiry structurally without a fabricated branch citation.
The prefixed فَ in فَيُعَذِّبُهُ marks the focus action as following the refusal in 88:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, report, directed perception, measurable formation, reminder, concealment, and examination; I infer an evidentiary progression whose refusal increases the weight of the consequence. A live alternative is that punishment follows only the immediately stated turning and disbelief, with the earlier disclosures serving illustration rather than procedural stages.

changed_reading.before: The greater punishment appears as an isolated threat attached only to disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It becomes the terminal consequence of an epistemic sequence: report, inspection, reminder, deliberate covering, and final examination, with greater registering cumulative refusal as well as severity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is assigned to the human addressee, control is explicitly negated, refusal is assigned to the one who turns away and covers, and punishment, return, and accounting are assigned to Allah. The focus is therefore a jurisdictional transfer, not an extension of human coercive authority.

activation_trace.role: The fixed divine name explicitly assigns the punitive act to Allah.
Punishment supplies the sanction whose proper agent and place in the sequence are delimited.
Reminder as what makes one remember supplies the messenger's positively assigned function.
Negation of a present state supplies the explicit removal of coercive status.
The controlling overseer supplies the authority specifically denied to the reminder.
Turning away supplies the addressee's own refusal rather than an act produced by the reminder.
Concealing the truth supplies the accountable obstruction attributed to the refuser.
Return to a destination supplies the movement back into divine jurisdiction.
Counting and accounting supply the final adjudicative function assigned to the divine side.

structural_cues: إِنَّمَا in 88:21 restricts the human role, and لَّسْتَ in 88:22 negates control.
The grammatical subject changes to ٱللَّهُ in 88:24, followed by إِلَيْنَا in 88:25 and عَلَيْنَا in 88:26.
The object pronoun in يُعَذِّبُهُ links the sanction to the singular refuser of 88:23 without transferring agency to the reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restricted reminder, negated control, refusal, explicit divine agency, return, and accounting; I infer a jurisdictional handoff that blocks human enforcement from the focus threat. A live alternative concerns the exact syntactic reach of the exception in 88:23, but no reading erases the explicit subject shift in 88:24.

changed_reading.before: The threat could be heard as intensifying the preceding address into a mandate to compel.
changed_reading.after: The focus instead seals a division of authority: the messenger reminds but does not control; the refuser chooses turning and concealment; Allah alone punishes, receives the return, and accounts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two face tableaux establish persons by their presented fronts, turning away reverses that orientation, and return cancels the attempted distance. The focus punishment occupies the hinge where an evasive motion becomes an unavoidable re-encounter.

activation_trace.role: Punishment supplies the consequential hinge between turning away and compelled return.
The divine name supplies the destination and agent whom attempted distancing cannot evade.
The face standing for the self supplies the person as a visibly oriented whole.
The face and forward aspect repeat orientation on the contrasting outcome.
Turning the face and approaching supply the positive orientation whose reversal is available in the same root.
Turning the back and withdrawing supply the actual evasive motion immediately before the focus.
Return to the destination supplies the reversal that closes the attempted distance.

structural_cues: Faces recur at the opening of both outcome scenes in 88:2 and 88:8.
The singular object pronoun of 88:24 follows the singular one who turns away in 88:23, and return follows immediately in 88:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faces, both directions of turning, punishment, and return; I infer a spatial arrow in which evasion collapses into re-encounter. A live alternative is that the face descriptions and the later turning are independent idioms with no shared orientation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an event imposed after a doctrinal refusal.
changed_reading.after: Punishment is also the hinge of a failed escape: the self turns its presented face away, but return reverses the motion and makes encounter unavoidable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily activates punishment, not the root's branch for being open to the sky. It remains anchored by the exact focus-root inventory and by a context sequence dense with covering, shelter, sky, and concealment. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory exposure mechanism, never as a replacement gloss for عَذَاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ع ذ ب inventory includes the state of having no cover between oneself and the sky.

activation_trace.role: Being open to the sky supplies forced exposure as the outlier's focus-side material image.
Torment and punishment keep exposure subordinate to the penal construction.
A cover rising over and concealing a thing supplies the opening state against which exposure reverses.
Sheltering and concealment supply the protected alternative associated with the garden scene.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the cover from which the focus branch imagines removal.
Covering supplies the refuser's own concealment, which the exposure reading then reverses.

changed_reading.before: The greater punishment is maximal pain under an unspecified condition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also radical unsheltering: the one who covers is stripped of every protective cover and left exposed beneath the very sky invoked in the focus root's distant branch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain material analogy is surprising because the camel passage does not lexically define punishment. It remains worth carrying because the packet independently pairs camel capacity with water abstention and burden, exactly the two focus branches activated by ع ذ ب and ك ب ر. Render it as a capacity analogy, not as an encoded animal reference in 88:24.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories permit punishment to be heard through bodily abstention and greatness as a heavy, difficult load.

activation_trace.role: Abstention from food and drink supplies the endurance stress carried by the focus root.
Hardship and heaviness supply the load whose excess defines greater.
Making do without water supplies a visible creaturely model of adaptation to abstention.
Weight and liability supply the same creature's burden-bearing capacity.
Giving drink supplies the immediate deprivation domain against which the camel's water endurance is measured.

changed_reading.before: Greater means more severe without specifying a relation to bodily capacity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the punishment exceeds even the imagined conjunction of thirst endurance and burden-bearing: it is deprivation and load beyond adaptive capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant retained activation: womb, fetus, childbirth, creation, seniority, and return do not make عَذَاب mean birth. It remains anchored because both focus roots provide exact womb/afterbirth and birth-order branches, while the context supplies concealed gestation and delivery. Downstream prose must mark it as a speculative material model of forced emergence into accountability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories contain ع ذ ب as womb and afterbirth and ك ب ر as birth-order seniority.

activation_trace.role: Womb and afterbirth supply a material passage from enclosure to exposed life.
Birth-order seniority supplies a distant way for greater to mark an emergence ranked beyond an earlier birth.
The fetus hidden in the belly supplies protected gestation before emergence.
Laying down a burden through childbirth supplies the transition out of enclosure.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the emergence frame at creaturely scale.
Return to the destination turns emergence into arrival before accountability.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is externally applied to an already exposed subject.
changed_reading.after: In a tightly contained outlier, punishment resembles a second, harsher emergence: concealment breaks, the burden is laid down, and the subject is delivered into unavoidable return and accounting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it treats أَكْبَرَ relationally as a contest rather than only as degree. It remains close to the focus inventory, where ك ب ر explicitly includes self-magnification, rightful divine majesty, and overcoming, and the context supplies abasement plus turning away from truth. Render it as a coexisting reversal of posture, not as proof that every refuser is lexically called arrogant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective أَكْبَرَ sits beside the divine subject and can activate both grandeur and overcoming within its own root inventory.

activation_trace.role: Majesty, self-exaltation, and refusal of truth supply competing postures of greatness.
Contending and overcoming supply the directional result in which one claim to greatness defeats another.
The fixed divine name supplies the rightful agent beside whom the comparative adjective stands.
Punishment supplies the concrete means by which the posture of self-exaltation is overcome.
Lowering and submission supply the reversed posture produced on the punished side.
Turning away supplies refusal as a posture of attempted independence.
Concealing truth supplies the resisted claim that the greater punishment answers.

changed_reading.before: The greater punishment simply exceeds a lesser punishment quantitatively.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting relational reading hears it as the overcoming of false self-magnification: attempted independence turns into abasement before the rightful divine greatness.

strongest_changes: The food-and-drink sequence transforms punishment into a coherent anti-nourishment system rather than a list of disconnected pains.
The work/exhaustion and striving/satisfaction contrast recasts punishment as effort whose wage and yield are withheld.
The reminder, non-control, explicit divine subject, return, and accounting sequence makes 88:24 a jurisdictional boundary against human coercive ownership of the threat.
The creation-inspection sequence moves the focus from isolated threat to consequence after multiple disclosure channels.
The vertical and material sequence gives أَكْبَرَ a felt sense of uncarryable load in addition to abstract intensity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually productive because ع ذ ب is doubled as verb and noun while its inventory spans torment, palatability, abstention, withholding, exposure, and birth material, and ك ب ر spans scale, burden, grandeur, and overcoming. The context repeatedly supplies exact domains that can activate those latent branches without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: أَكْبَرَ may be an absolute superlative, a comparison with an unstated lesser punishment, a burden-quality, or a relational overcoming; the packet does not force one comparand.
The exact syntactic reach of the exception in 88:23 can alter the fine detail of the jurisdictional handoff, though the explicit agency assignments remain visible.
The non-dominant س و ق mapping under the 88:5 س ق ي cue adds a possible coercive motion but should remain secondary to the direct watering branch.
The exposure, camel-capacity, birth-emergence, and contest models are branch-backed exploratory activations, not lexical replacements for the surface reading.
